_description: Unified control-mapping schema for evidence governance across CJIS, SOC2, HIPAA, NIBRS. Every collected evidence entry carries framework, control ID, policy version, timestamps, and source system.
_usage: Each piece of compliance evidence references this schema. Evidence artifacts (prescan.json, compliance-control.json, audit logs) tag their results with control_id + framework + policy_version, enabling automatic expiry, auditor reconstruction, and cross-framework correlation.

framework.description: Compliance framework this evidence belongs to.

control_id.description: Control ID in framework namespace. Examples: CC6.1 (SOC2 TSC), 164.312(b) (HIPAA), 11.1.1 (CJIS), offense_code_37 (NIBRS).

control_description.description: Human-readable control description for auditor reference.

policy_version.description: Policy/standard version. Examples: 5.9.5 (CJIS), TSC 2024 (SOC2), 45 CFR 164 (HIPAA), FBI UCR 2024 (NIBRS).

collection_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime when evidence was collected.

expiry_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime when evidence expires (null = non-expiring).

evidence_path.description: Relative path to evidence artifact. Example: .keel/state/HART-287/prescan.json

content_hash.description: SHA256 hash of evidence content (tamper detection).

status.description: Current status: COLLECTED=new, VERIFIED=validated, EXPIRED=past expiry, REVOKED=invalidated.

notes.description: Auditor-facing notes about evidence origin and validation.

exception.description: If control has approved exception, document it here.

exception_expiry.description: ISO 8601 date when exception expires (if time-limited).

control_status_summary.description: Summary of control status for given framework and policy version.

overall_status.description: Computed status based on evidence freshness and exceptions.

evidence_count.description: Total evidence entries for this control.

fresh_evidence_count.description: Evidence entries still within expiry window.
